description_en: Queries the information list of all instance types provided by Elastic Compute Service (ECS) and retrieves detailed information about instance types. You can also perform a conditional query for specific instance types to understand the configurations and performance of different instance types and select instances that meet your business requirements
description_zh: 本接口主要用于查询云服务器ECS提供的所有实例规格的信息列表并关联获取实例规格的详细信息，也可根据特定条件查询指定实例规格的信息，帮助您了解不同实例规格的配置和性能，以便选择适合自己业务需求的实例

LocalStorageAmount.description_zh: 实例挂载的本地盘的数量

LocalStorageCapacity.description_en: The capacity of a single local disk attached to the instance. Unit: GiB
LocalStorageCapacity.description_zh: 实例挂载的本地盘的单盘容量。单位：GiB

LocalStorageCategory.description_en: The category of local disks. For more information, see [Local disks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/63138.html）. Valid values:
LocalStorageCategory.description_zh:
本地盘类型。更多信息，请参见[本地盘]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/63138.html）。可能值：

local_hdd_pro：实例规格族d1ne和d1搭载的SATA HDD本地盘。
local_ssd_pro：实例规格族i2、i2g、i1、ga1和gn5等搭载的NVMe SSD本地盘

MaximumQueueNumberPerEni.description_en: The maximum number of queues per network interface controller (NIC), including primary and secondary NICs
MaximumQueueNumberPerEni.description_zh: 单块弹性网卡最大队列数。包括主网卡及辅助网卡支持的队列数

NetworkCardQuantity.description_en: The number of network cards supported by the instance type
NetworkCardQuantity.description_zh: 实例规格支持的物理网卡数量

NetworkCardInfo.description_en: The list of network card information

NetworkCardIndex.description_en: The index of the network card

NetworkEncryptionSupport.description_en: Indicates whether the instance supports VPC network traffic encryption. Valid values:
NetworkEncryptionSupport.description_zh:
实例是否支持VPC网络流量加密，可能值：

true：支持VPC网络流量加密。
false：不支持VPC网络流量加密。
该参数正在邀测中，暂未开放使用

BandwidthWeighting.description_en: The bandwidth weighting supported by the instance type

WeightingInfo.description_en: The bandwidth weighting information. This field is returned only when NetworkInfo.BandwidthWeighting is specified in the AdditionalAttributes request parameter
WeightingInfo.description_zh: 带宽权重信息。需要在入参AdditionalAttributes 中指定NetworkInfo.BandwidthWeighting 时才返回该字段

EbsBandwidth.description_en: The baseline storage bandwidth. Unit: Kbit/s

EbsBurstBandwidth.description_en: The burst storage bandwidth. This field is not returned if the instance type does not support storage performance bursting. Unit: Kbit/s
EbsBurstBandwidth.description_zh: 存储突发带宽，该规格不支持存储性能突发时不返回。单位：Kbit/s

VpcBandwidth.description_en: The baseline network bandwidth. Unit: Kbit/s

VpcBurstBandwidth.description_en: The burst network bandwidth. This field is not returned if the instance type does not support network performance bursting. Unit: Kbit/s
VpcBurstBandwidth.description_zh: 网络突发带宽，该规格不支持网络性能突发时不返回。单位：Kbit/s

NvmeSupport.description_en: Indicates whether disks attached to the instance type support NVMe. Valid values:
NvmeSupport.description_zh:
实例规格所挂载的云盘是否支持NVMe。可能值：
required：支持。表示云盘以NVMe的方式挂载。
unsupported：不支持。表示云盘不以NVMe的方式挂载

PrimaryEniQueueNumber.description_en: The default number of queues supported by the primary ENI

QueuePairNumber.description_en: The maximum number of queue pair (QP) queues for all Elastic RDMA Interfaces (ERIs) on the instance. The value is related to the instance type. For each network interface controller (NIC):
QueuePairNumber.description_zh:
实例所有弹性RDMA网卡（ERI）的QP（QueuePair）队列数上限和实例规格有关，对于：
企业级CPU实例：`QueuePairNumber`，即实例规格允许的所有弹性RDMA网卡的QP数量上限。

GPU实例：允许的所有网卡QP数上限为`QueuePairNumber * NetworkCardQuantity`

SecondaryEniQueueNumber.description_en: The default number of queues supported by the secondary network interface controller (NIC)
SecondaryEniQueueNumber.description_zh: 辅助弹性网卡默认队列数

SecureBootSupport.description_en: Indicates whether the instance type supports secure boot. Valid values:
SecureBootSupport.description_zh:
实例规格是否支持安全启动。可能值：
supported：支持安全启动。
unsupported：不支持安全启动
SecureBootSupport.title_zh:
实例规格是否支持安全启动。
supported：支持安全启动。
unsupported：不支持安全启动。

SupportedBootMode.description_en: The boot modes supported by the instance type

items.description_zh:
启动模式，可能值：
BIOS：仅支持BIOS启动模式。 
UEFI：仅支持UEFI启动模式。
BIOS,UEFI：支持BIOS和UEFI启动模式

TotalEniQueueQuantity.description_en: The total quota of network interface controller (NIC) queues that can be modified for the instance type
TotalEniQueueQuantity.description_zh: 实例规格允许修改的弹性网卡队列数总配额

NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证（Token）
